title: LED Matrix Pattern Designer
description: Draw on an 8x8 grid and watch the eight bytes that would produce it appear beside the picture.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given an 8x8 LED matrix grid, the learner constructs a simple pattern or letter by toggling individual pixels and reads off the resulting byte values.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click or drag on the grid to toggle LEDs; load a preset and read off its bytes
pedagogical.assessment: Design a letter and hand someone only the eight hex values to redraw it from.
